adjudication.rationale: The diff adds a new security-sensitive webhook handler at `apps/web/pages/api/webhook/app-credential.ts` (shared-secret header auth, decrypts payload, and creates/updates `prisma.credential`). This PR diff does not add any accompanying tests for the main branches/error paths the finding lists. Additionally, the handler uses `appCredentialWebhookRequestBodySchema.parse(req.body)` and `symmetricDecrypt(...)` without any try/catch, so malformed bodies or decrypt failures will throw and surface as 500s—exactly the kind of behavior tests would catch. However, the claim that there are “no tests at all” in the repo can’t be strictly verified from the diff alone; only that none were added/updated here.
